title: Fisher-Based Sensitivity Framework for Rydberg Atom Microwave Electrometry
abstract: Develops a Fisher information framework for Rydberg-atom microwave electrometers exploiting EIT and AT splitting. Derives the fundamental quantum sensitivity limit. Shows Fisher-optimized sensitivity below 1 nV/cm/sqrt(Hz) is achievable with suppression of technical noise. Published in Phys. Rev. Applied 2026.
key_claims: Fisher-optimized sensitivity limit below 1 nV/cm/sqrt(Hz) in Cs vapor
Current experiments limited by technical noise, not fundamental quantum limit
Provides systematic framework for optimizing EIT readout parameters
Identifies path to 10-100x sensitivity improvement over current SOTA
